Max Verstappen won the most races at Circuit of the Americas in the provided documents, with four wins: the 2021 (Document 8), 2022 (Document 3), 2023 (Document 1) and 2025 (Document 4) United States Grands Prix. The 2000 and 2006 races were held at Indianapolis, and the Canadian races are at a different circuit, so I excluded them. The documents don't cover 2024 or 2020, so this count is limited to what's listed.

ANSWER: Max Verstappen
